```{r setup}
# PAGE is set by the page that includes this file; REPORT_DATA by make_report.R (data/cache/report-latest.rds)
for (f in c("data", "ui", "sim", "brand", "report", "card", "standings_section", "sim_section", "money_section", "sections")) source(file.path("R", paste0(f, ".R")))
D <- readRDS(if (exists("REPORT_FILE")) REPORT_FILE else "data/cache/report-latest.rds")
NAV_PREFIX <- if (exists("NAV_PREFIX")) NAV_PREFIX else ""
```

```{r body}
tagList(page_head(D, if (PAGE == "index") "Standings" else PAGES[[PAGE]], if (PAGE == "index") "Fantasy1 Championship Weekly" else PAGES[[PAGE]]),
        page_nav(PAGE, function(p) paste0(NAV_PREFIX, p, ".html")),
        section_body(PAGE, D),
        page_foot(D))
```
